Class GtReceiptDefs.Labels

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.receipt.GtReceiptDefs.Labels
Enclosing class:
GtReceiptDefs
public static final class GtReceiptDefs.Labels extends Object
Immutable per language label set. Every label that starts a value line acts as the import template's line anchor and must stay unique within a receipt (see class Javadoc).
